title.zh: 工艺选择：带隙、掺杂与势垒怎么配
title.en: Process selection: matching gap, doping and barriers

subtitle.zh: 材料体系 / 掺杂路线 / 接触界面 / 器件目标
subtitle.en: Material system / doping route / contact interface / device goals

body.zh: 没有单独最好的能带，须匹配电压、温度、速度、漏电和光学目标。原图表：Ge窄带隙约0.7 eV，本征载流子高、漏电倾向大、击穿场低、红外响应；Si中等带隙1.1 eV，载流子适中、漏电/场强中等、可见/近红外；GaN/SiC宽带隙3.2–3.4 eV，本征浓度很低、漏电小、场强高、紫外/可见。宽带隙高温高场更稳，但激活和低阻欧姆接触更难。
body.en: No band structure is best alone; match voltage, temperature, speed, leakage and optics. Source table: Ge ~0.7 eV, high intrinsic carriers/leakage, low breakdown field, infrared; Si 1.1 eV, moderate carriers/leakage/field, visible/near-IR; GaN/SiC 3.2–3.4 eV, very low intrinsic carriers/leakage, high field, UV/visible. Wide gaps improve high-temperature/field operation but complicate activation and low-resistance contacts.

body.zh: 原位掺杂在外延生长中引入：轮廓控制好、激活需求低、晶格损伤小、热预算低—中，典型外延层。扩散在高温使杂质向内：轮廓控制较差、激活需求较高、损伤小、热预算高，用深结/均匀掺杂。离子注入后退火：轮廓控制很好、需退火、损伤较大、热预算中—高，用浅结/精准轮廓。浓度影响电阻/阈值，过高增强散射漏电，需权衡激活与损伤。
body.en: In-situ epitaxial doping: good profile control, lower activation demand, little damage, low–medium thermal budget, used in epitaxial layers. Thermal diffusion: poorer profile control, higher activation demand as described, little damage, high budget, used for deep/uniform doping. Implantation plus anneal: very good profile control, anneal required, more damage, medium–high budget, used for shallow/precise profiles. Concentration affects resistance/threshold but excessive doping increases scattering/leakage.

body.zh: 欧姆接触：能带/功函数匹配，势垒薄或可隧穿，低电阻、界面态影响较小，用源漏/电极，挑战是高掺杂/低阻。肖特基：势垒φ_B形成整流，界面态影响可能大，接触电阻中—高，用二极管/传感器，需控势垒高。绝缘界面如栅氧：抑制注入，形成绝缘势垒，电阻很高，界面态决定阈值/可靠性，用MOS栅，需控稳定性。宽带隙低阻接触可通过高掺杂、金属选择或界面工程优化。
body.en: Ohmic contacts use alignment and thin/tunnelable barriers for low resistance, often at source/drain/electrodes, with high-doping/low-resistance challenges. Schottky contacts use φ_B for rectification; interface effects may be large and resistance medium–high, for diodes/sensors with barrier-height control. Dielectric interfaces such as gate oxide block injection, have high resistance and interface-dependent threshold/reliability, for MOS gates. Wide-gap contacts may need high doping, suitable metals or interface engineering.

body.zh: 明确电压/速度、温度、波长/漏电、可靠性目标 → 选材料带隙并评击穿光学与工艺可行性 → 定n/p、浓度、结深梯度、阈值电阻 → 选原位/扩散/注入及激活、热预算/损伤控制 → 设计欧姆/肖特基/绝缘界面、功函数与接触 → 电学测量对标并迭代。维度为E_g/临界场/耐温、迁移率/开关频率、掺杂浓度轮廓与激活、界面态/接触稳定性。
body.en: Define voltage/speed, temperature, wavelength/leakage and reliability → choose gap/material and assess breakdown/optics/process feasibility → set type, concentration, depth/gradient, threshold/resistance → select doping/activation/budget/damage control → design contacts/interfaces/work function → electrically verify and iterate. Assess gap/critical field/temperature, mobility/switching frequency, profile/activation and interface/contact stability.

body.zh: 宽带隙降漏电增击穿但激活接触难；重掺降阻却增散射、降迁移率、增漏电；低热预算减损伤却可能激活不足；高势垒抑漏电却增接触阻。风险：路线目标不匹配、激活不足或剖面偏移、势垒过高或E_F钉扎、界面态使阈值漂移/可靠性下降。
body.en: Wide gaps trade leakage/breakdown against activation/contacts; heavy doping trades resistance against scattering/mobility/leakage; low thermal budget may limit activation; high barriers suppress leakage but raise contact resistance. Risks include route/goal mismatch, poor activation/shifted profiles, excessive barriers/Fermi pinning and interface-induced threshold/reliability issues.

body.zh: Hall/片阻测浓度、迁移率和片阻；SIMS/SRP查掺杂分布、结深轮廓；C–V查掺杂、界面态与氧化层；I–V查接触、整流和漏电；吸收/发光查带隙、效率与材料质量。逻辑要高速低功耗低漏电；功率要高压高温可靠性；射频要高频低损耗；光电要特定波长吸收/发光；传感要高灵敏低噪。不同器件没有统一材料和工艺方案。
body.en: Hall/sheet resistance measures carriers/mobility/resistance; SIMS/SRP checks profiles/depth; C–V checks doping/interfaces/oxide; I–V checks contacts/rectification/leakage; optics checks gap/efficiency/material quality. Logic targets speed/low power/leakage; power targets voltage/temperature/reliability; RF high frequency/low loss; optoelectronics wavelength-specific absorption/emission; sensors sensitivity/low noise. No universal route covers all.

notes.zh: 材料表的数值、光谱范围及工艺热预算是原图定性/代表性比较，须按具体材料、结构、温度与实际配方使用，不能视为固定工艺规格。
notes.en: Material values, spectral ranges and thermal budgets are representative source comparisons, not fixed specifications; apply them with the specific material, structure, temperature and process.

Main trade-offs
• Wider gap → less leakage and higher breakdown, but harder activation and contacts
• Heavier doping → lower resistance, but stronger scattering, lower mobility and more leakage
• Lower thermal budget → less damage, but potentially insufficient dopant activation
• Higher barrier → less leakage, but higher contact resistance
